create_module_meta: create a _ModuleMeta instance from raw nn_module_stack meta data produced by FX or Dynamo tracers
build_modular_graph: build a modular fx.GraphModule from a flattened graph by grouping nodes belonging to the same nn.Module forward call
run_modularize_pass: run the Modularize pass on an exported fx.GraphModule to transform it into a modular structure with call_module nodes
extract_module_inputs: extract module inputs from a sequence of fx nodes by identifying args produced by nodes outside the module
extract_module_outputs: extract module outputs from a sequence of fx nodes by identifying nodes used by nodes outside the module
